description:
Fair Deal Property, Your Trusted Partners for Residential Property Sales

Are delighted to present to the market Number 39 Palace Fields.

Palace Fields is an outstanding residential development, originally constructed by J.J. Rattigan in 2002. The estate has been maintained to an impeccably high standard and benefits from an excellent residents’ association.

This impressive four-bedroom detached residence occupies a prime position towards the front of the development, overlooking a large and beautifully landscaped green area. The property is also ideally positioned within a quiet cul-de-sac with no passing traffic, creating a peaceful and secure setting that is particularly well suited to families with young children.

Extending to approximately 120 sq. m., the property offers generously proportioned and thoughtfully arranged living accommodation. Freshly painted throughout and presented in walk-in condition, Number 39 is ready for its new owners to simply move in and enjoy. The property has also recently benefited from fully refurbished fascia and soffit, further enhancing this exceptionally well-maintained home.

Upon arrival, you are welcomed by a spacious entrance hallway leading into a large living room featuring a bay window and an attractive feature fireplace. Double doors connect the living room to a bright and spacious open-plan kitchen and dining area, which offers ample fitted cabinetry and glazed patio doors opening onto the perfectly proportioned rear garden.

A well-appointed guest WC completes the ground-floor accommodation.

Upstairs, there are four well-laid-out bedrooms comprising two doubles and two singles, all of which benefit from generous built-in wardrobes. The spacious principal bedroom features a bay window and private en-suite bathroom. A well-proportioned family bathroom completes the accommodation in this wonderfully located home.

Number 39 enjoys an exceptionally convenient setting just a short stroll from the Palace Grounds, one of County Galway’s finest public parks. Local amenities include a children’s playground, walking trails, a gymnasium, swimming pool and recently refurbished tennis courts.

Palace Fields is located just one minute from the N17/M18 motorway connection and less than a ten-minute walk from the centre of Tuam town, offering an excellent combination of peaceful residential living and outstanding accessibility.

If you are searching for an attractive four-bedroom detached residence in one of Tuam’s most desirable and convenient locations, positioned in a quiet cul-de-sac, overlooking a magnificent green area and presented in walk-in condition, then look no further than Number 39 Palace Fields.

This exceptional family home is certain to meet all your requirements.

Viewing is highly recommended.

Brought to you by Fair Deal Property, Your Trusted Experts for Residential Property Sales.
